frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: High-mass star-forming regions with VLBI trigonometric maser parallaxes compiled by Reid et al. (2019), Table 1, at 1/parallax: the most accurate distances across the disc, a few beyond the Galactic centre.

appearance.note: Presentation only: near-white, the brightest of the disc tracers.
appearance.emphasis: Arm tracer: young, massive star formation that outlines the spiral arms, drawn at full strength.

mapWeight.basis: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 2.4 and Eq. 2: a weight for the kind of tracer, times 0.5/σ in each disc axis (1 when σ < 0.5 kpc) for a kinematic distance, with σ from a ±7 km/s velocity uncertainty through a flat rotation curve (R0 = 8.3 kpc, Θ0 = 239 km/s, their adopted set). The paper's maser weight, 0.1; trigonometric parallaxes, so no kinematic factor.
